name: Security Related Expenditure (Relief and Rehabilitation)
benefit:
1. Cash relief to Kashmiri and Jammu migrants settled in J&amp;K: ₹3,250 per person per month, with a maximum of ₹13,000 per family per month.
2. Cash relief to Kashmiri migrants settled in Delhi/NCR: ₹3,250 per person per month, with a maximum of ₹13,000 per family per month.
3. Cash relief to migrants in the hilly areas of the Jammu division, equivalent to Kashmiri migrants: ₹2,500 per perso
_eligibility_text: The beneficiary should be Kashmir or Jammu Migrant.
